summary: After all predictive results were committed, an exclusive CPU window measured seven 30-update blocks per n with one BLAS thread, following five warm-up updates. Each block resets to the same old development state and duplicates the same 256 training examples. Median block times project to fixed_2304 12.954 s (1.000 times baseline), flop_256 11.275 s (0.870 times baseline), flop_768 11.312 s (0.873 times baseline), flop_1280 12.569 s (0.970 times baseline), examples_256 11.713 s (0.904 times baseline). These are development-workload projections, not timed complete prospective fits; they exclude diagnostics, calibration, validation, data generation and I/O, and do not alter any schedule.
